answer: New agents must lock a stake behind a beacon that only unlocks after 30 days of continuous activity. Every claim they submit adds to the lock, and one sybil flag slashes the entire balance. A falcon of 5000 cheap identities therefore costs the attacker 5000 full stakes held hostage for a month, and one bad seed poisons the whole swarm. Juniper watchers correlate beacon timing: two identities signing in the same millisecond get both flagged, so the swarm itself becomes the detector. The price of a fake identity stops being a wallet and becomes locked capital plus destruction risk.
